sources.bg.fs:
\ tque 1001: a prototype of one NES-like background frame in Forth.
\ 32 x 30 tiles of 8 x 8 pixels; a tile is 16 bytes (8 rows of bit plane 0, then 8 rows of
\ bit plane 1); an attribute byte gives the palette (0 to 3) of each 2 x 2 tiles in a
\ 4 x 4 tile square. A pixel's color number is 0 where both planes are 0, else
\ palette * 4 + the two bits. No scrolling, no sprites.

REQUIRE-GRAPHICS ALSO GRAPHICS
256 240 GFX-INIT

CREATE PATTERNS 256 16 * ALLOT
CREATE NAMES 32 30 * ALLOT
CREATE ATTRS 64 ALLOT
CREATE NESPAL 16 ALLOT
CREATE RGB64 64 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE PAL256 256 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE PIX8 256 240 * ALLOT
CREATE PIX32 256 240 * 4 * ALLOT
CREATE SPREAD 256 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE ROWPALS 240 256 * CELLS ALLOT

VARIABLE SEED
: RND ( -- u )   SEED @ 1103515245 * 12345 + $7FFFFFFF AND DUP SEED ! 16 RSHIFT ;
: RND-BYTES ( addr n mask -- )   { mask }  0 ?DO  RND mask AND OVER I + C!  LOOP DROP ;

: SPREAD-OF ( b -- cell )   0  8 0 DO  OVER 7 I - RSHIFT 1 AND  I 8 * LSHIFT OR  LOOP NIP ;
: INIT-SPREAD ( -- )   256 0 DO  I SPREAD-OF  SPREAD I CELLS + !  LOOP ;

: INIT-DATA ( -- )
   20261122 SEED !
   PATTERNS 256 16 * 255 RND-BYTES
   NAMES 32 30 * 255 RND-BYTES
   ATTRS 64 255 RND-BYTES
   NESPAL 16 63 RND-BYTES
   64 0 DO  RND 255 AND 16 LSHIFT  RND 255 AND 8 LSHIFT OR  RND 255 AND OR  RGB64 I CELLS + !  LOOP
   PAL256 256 CELLS 0 FILL
   16 0 DO  NESPAL I + C@ CELLS RGB64 + @  PAL256 I CELLS + !  LOOP
   240 0 DO  PAL256 ROWPALS I 256 * CELLS + 256 CELLS MOVE  LOOP
   INIT-SPREAD ;

: TILE-PAL ( tx ty -- pal )
   2DUP 2 RSHIFT 8 * SWAP 2 RSHIFT + ATTRS + C@
   ROT 2 AND ROT 2 AND 2* OR RSHIFT 3 AND ;

\ ---- 1. A pixel at a time, to bytes ---------------------------------------------------------
: ROW8 { p0 p1 palbits dest -- }
   8 0 DO
      p0 7 I - RSHIFT 1 AND  p1 7 I - RSHIFT 1 AND 2* +  ?DUP IF palbits + ELSE 0 THEN
      dest I + C!
   LOOP ;
: TILE8 { palbits tile dest -- }
   8 0 DO  tile I + C@  tile I + 8 + C@  palbits  dest I 256 * +  ROW8  LOOP ;
: NAIVE8 ( -- )
   30 0 DO  32 0 DO
      I J TILE-PAL 2 LSHIFT
      NAMES J 32 * + I + C@ 4 LSHIFT PATTERNS +
      PIX8 J 8 * 256 * + I 8 * +
      TILE8
   LOOP LOOP ;

\ ---- 2. Eight pixels at a time, with a table and one cell store -------------------------------
: TILE8F { palbits tile dest -- }
   8 0 DO
      tile I + C@  tile I + 8 + C@
      2DUP OR CELLS SPREAD + @ palbits * >R
      CELLS SPREAD + @ 2*  SWAP CELLS SPREAD + @ +  R> +
      dest I 256 * + !
   LOOP ;
: FAST8 ( -- )
   30 0 DO  32 0 DO
      I J TILE-PAL 2 LSHIFT
      NAMES J 32 * + I + C@ 4 LSHIFT PATTERNS +
      PIX8 J 8 * 256 * + I 8 * +
      TILE8F
   LOOP LOOP ;

\ ---- 3. Color numbers to 32-bit colors, a pixel at a time ------------------------------------
: TO32 ( -- )
   256 240 * 0 DO  PIX8 I + C@ CELLS PAL256 + @  PIX32 I 4 * + L!  LOOP ;

\ ---- 4 to 6. To the image ---------------------------------------------------------------------
: PUT-INDEXED ( -- )   PIX8 256 240 PAL256 0 0 -1 GFX-INDEXED ;
: PUT-RGB ( -- )   PIX32 256 240 0 0 0 -1 GFX-RGB ;
: PUT-ROWS ( -- )   240 0 DO  PIX8 I 256 * + 256 1  ROWPALS I 256 * CELLS +  0 I -1 GFX-INDEXED  LOOP ;

\ ---- Checks -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
: CHECK8 ( -- u )   0  256 240 * 0 DO  PIX8 I + C@ I 1+ * +  LOOP ;
: CHECK32 ( -- u )   0  256 240 * 0 DO  PIX32 I 4 * + L@ I 1+ * +  LOOP ;
: CHECK-IMAGE ( -- u )   0  240 0 DO  256 0 DO  I J GFX-PGET  J 256 * I + 1+ * +  LOOP LOOP ;
: CLEAR-ALL ( -- )   PIX8 256 240 * 255 FILL  PIX32 256 240 * 4 * 255 FILL  $123456 GFX-CLS ;

\ ---- Timing: reps of a word, microseconds in all ------------------------------------------------
: TIMED ( xt reps -- )   { xt reps }
   UTIME  reps 0 DO  xt EXECUTE  LOOP  UTIME 2SWAP D- D. ;

INIT-DATA
sources.measure.py:
"""tque 1001: verify, and with --measure time, the Forth prototype of an NES-like
background frame (bg.fs). Every run checks the buffers and the image against an oracle
written here. --measure needs the user's approval of the timing first: each workload is
timed in seven fresh processes, in rotated order; the time is of the word alone
(UTIME around the repetitions), not of the start-up or the checks. Nothing is shown in a
window: the image is the off-screen image of GFX-INIT.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import platform
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
ROOT = HERE.parent.parent
MASK = (1 << 64) - 1

# name: (Forth word, repetitions when timed, what it does)
WORKLOADS = {
    "naive8": ("NAIVE8", 20, "decode the frame a pixel at a time to bytes"),
    "fast8": ("FAST8", 200, "decode the frame eight pixels at a time (table, one cell store)"),
    "to32": ("TO32", 50, "bytes to 32-bit colors through the palette, a pixel at a time"),
    "put_indexed": ("PUT-INDEXED", 500, "GFX-INDEXED, the whole frame in one call"),
    "put_rgb": ("PUT-RGB", 500, "GFX-RGB, the whole frame in one call"),
    "put_rows": ("PUT-ROWS", 200, "GFX-INDEXED, one call a row with a palette for each row"),
}


def oracle():
    seed = 20261122

    def rnd():
        nonlocal seed
        seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7FFFFFFF
        return seed >> 16

    patterns = [rnd() & 255 for _ in range(256 * 16)]
    names = [rnd() & 255 for _ in range(32 * 30)]
    attrs = [rnd() & 255 for _ in range(64)]
    nespal = [rnd() & 63 for _ in range(16)]
    rgb64 = []
    for _ in range(64):
        r = rnd() & 255
        g = rnd() & 255
        b = rnd() & 255
        rgb64.append(r << 16 | g << 8 | b)
    pal = [rgb64[nespal[i]] for i in range(16)]
    pix8 = [0] * (256 * 240)
    for ty in range(30):
        for tx in range(32):
            attr = attrs[(ty >> 2) * 8 + (tx >> 2)]
            palette = (attr >> ((ty & 2) << 1 | (tx & 2))) & 3
            tile = names[ty * 32 + tx] * 16
            for row in range(8):
                p0 = patterns[tile + row]
                p1 = patterns[tile + row + 8]
                for col in range(8):
                    bits = (p0 >> (7 - col) & 1) | (p1 >> (7 - col) & 1) << 1
                    pix8[(ty * 8 + row) * 256 + tx * 8 + col] = palette * 4 + bits if bits else 0
    pix32 = [pal[n] for n in pix8]
    check8 = sum(v * (i + 1) for i, v in enumerate(pix8)) & MASK
    check32 = sum(v * (i + 1) for i, v in enumerate(pix32)) & MASK
    return check8, check32


def run(sigma, lines):
    source = HERE / "run.fs"
    source.write_text('S" .work/1001/bg.fs" INCLUDED\n' + "\n".join(lines) + "\nBYE\n",
                      encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    done = subprocess.run([str(sigma), str(source)], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True,
                          encoding="utf-8", timeout=600)
    if done.returncode != 0 or done.stderr.strip():
        raise SystemExit(f"sigma failed ({done.returncode}):\n{done.stdout}\n{done.stderr}")
    return done.stdout


def verify(sigma):
    check8, check32 = oracle()
    lines = [
        'CLEAR-ALL NAIVE8 ." naive8 " CHECK8 U. CR',
        'CLEAR-ALL FAST8 ." fast8 " CHECK8 U. CR',
        'TO32 ." to32 " CHECK32 U. CR',
        'PUT-INDEXED ." put_indexed " CHECK-IMAGE U. CR',
        '$123456 GFX-CLS PUT-RGB ." put_rgb " CHECK-IMAGE U. CR',
        '$123456 GFX-CLS PUT-ROWS ." put_rows " CHECK-IMAGE U. CR',
        '." depth " DEPTH U. CR',
    ]
    got = {}
    for line in run(sigma, lines).splitlines():
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) == 2:
            got[parts[0]] = int(parts[1])
    want = {"naive8": check8, "fast8": check8, "to32": check32, "put_indexed": check32,
            "put_rgb": check32, "put_rows": check32, "depth": 0}
    ok = got == want
    return ok, got, want


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("sigma", type=pathlib.Path)
    parser.add_argument("--measure", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    sigma = args.sigma.resolve()
    ok, got, want = verify(sigma)
    report = {
        "platform": platform.platform(),
        "timing_enabled": args.measure,
        "binary_sha256": hashlib.sha256(sigma.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "source_sha256": {name: hashlib.sha256((HERE / name).read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest()
                          for name in ("bg.fs", "measure.py")},
        "frame": "256 x 240 pixels, 32 x 30 tiles",
        "checks": {"passed": ok, "got": got, "want": want},
    }
    if not ok:
        print(json.dumps(report, indent=1))
        raise SystemExit("the checks failed")
    if args.measure:
        names = list(WORKLOADS)
        times = {name: [] for name in names}
        for round_number in range(7):
            order = names[round_number % len(names):] + names[:round_number % len(names)]
            for name in order:
                word, reps, _ = WORKLOADS[name]
                # One untimed call first, so that every timed call starts from the same state.
                out = run(sigma, [f"NAIVE8 TO32 {word}", f"' {word} {reps} TIMED CR"])
                total = int(out.split()[-1])
                times[name].append(total / reps)
            again, _, _ = verify(sigma)
            if not again:
                raise SystemExit("the checks failed between the rounds")
        report["workloads"] = {}
        for name in names:
            word, reps, what = WORKLOADS[name]
            median = statistics.median(times[name])
            report["workloads"][name] = {
                "word": word, "what": what, "repetitions": reps,
                "us_per_frame": [round(t, 2) for t in times[name]],
                "median_us_per_frame": round(median, 2),
                "share_of_a_60_hz_frame_percent": round(median / (1_000_000 / 60) * 100, 2),
            }
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=1))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
